name: bonsai-garden-rt
_what: The oldest rt this core takes, and whose seal on an rt's RT-MANIFEST.json it believes (rt's spec, §4, §5). install-runtime takes an rt whose every byte matches its manifest, whose version is min-version or newer, and whose manifest carries an owner seal by one of signers over exactly its bytes, vouched for by the published keys at bon-sai.garden; anything else is refused. No hash and no commit: core names no rt as a dependency (the gardener, 2026-10-18). It moves up only when a core needs a newer rt, by hand. 0.9.0 since 2026-10-20: rt 0.8.4's garden MCP is locked to two packages with critical advisories (anyio, pyjwt), and rt 0.9.0-rc is the first locked past them; a label never orders a version, so 0.9.0-rc meets 0.9.0, and a pot on 0.8.4 moves with install-runtime --upgrade.
